research_question: Does an assigned high discharge rate retain a reproducible total effect on normalized capacity loss after accounting for cycle count, equivalent charge throughput, mean state of charge, and state-of-charge window, and can an autonomously forged representation transfer to an unseen protocol group?

allowed: assigned-protocol total effects inside the CALCE pouch-cell experiment
predictive representation transfer to held-out cells and one sealed protocol group
blocked: separation of current-density effects from internal heating without cell-temperature measurements
human-unknown law or breakthrough claims without independent-source replication and prior-art review

official_source.provider: University of Maryland CALCE Battery Research Group
official_source.experiment_summary: Graphite/LiCoO2 pouch cells assigned to SOC windows and C/2 or 2C discharge protocols; paired cells are available for each listed group.

preprocessing.unit_of_analysis: one diagnostic full-discharge capacity observation per cell and diagnostic cycle
preprocessing.primary_response: capacity divided by the first valid diagnostic capacity for the same cell
time_coordinates: registered equivalent-full-cycle throughput computed from assigned SOC window
preprocessing.outlier_policy: no outcome-value removal; parser failures and physical impossibilities are retained as counterexamples
preprocessing.learner_visibility: anonymous numeric controls, time coordinates, and normalized response; no chemistry, CALCE, SOC, or C-rate names

primary_metrics.prediction: RMSE of normalized capacity divided by the best registered baseline RMSE
primary_metrics.mechanism: held-out matched-group rate-effect direction and magnitude with cell bootstrap interval
primary_metrics.representation: sealed error ratio without refit and description-token reduction

success_conditions: sealed G20_80_2C prediction ratio below 0.80 without parameter refit
the selected representation is counterfactually sensitive to all controls it claims to use
rate-effect sign agrees in both registered matched SOC-window comparisons
all commitments precede sealed archive parsing
failure_conditions: any sealed access before the program commitment
selected program fails to beat the best registered baseline
rate-effect sign reverses across matched groups
cell bootstrap interval includes effects of both signs
representation is an identity, constant, target proxy, or behaviorally duplicate
a parser ambiguity changes the scientific conclusion
novelty_policy: Literature is unavailable to the learner until after sealed evaluation. A successful result remains a bounded experimental relation until independent-source replication, broad prior-art audit, and external review.
